title: Nine Years of Fridays
subtitle: 循环利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 循环利用（环境保护·循环利用与节约）
meta: 主题语境：循环利用（环境保护·循环利用与节约）　|　核心词汇：bin　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bin 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 my grandmother kept ① a bin by the back door and said the keeping was the whole of the habit. The ② bin, meaning the container and not the rubbish, was emptied on a Friday and was argued about on the Saturday; a bin, she said, is the only object in a house that is judged by how often it is forgotten.

Every ③ bin in that street had a different lid, and the ④ bin under the stairs, meaning the one for the paper and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever sorted properly. A bin, my mother said, is nine parts routine and one part knowing what goes where; my grandmother said the routine is the part that fails.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bin was the whole of the evening, meaning the emptying and not the container. The ⑥ bin, meaning the weekly trip and not any of that, is the only job in a house that everybody notices and nobody claims; a bin, he said, is either something you keep by the door or the only word that means both a container and an evening. She said the container came first.

By 1972 the ⑦ bin had become a photograph in a leaflet, and the leaflet had become an argument about what could go in it. The ⑧ bin of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in April, was nine years of Fridays and one sorted paper; a bin, she said, is either the thing under the stairs or the reason you learned which week it was. He said the week has never needed a lid.

The ⑨ bin I remember is the one under the stairs, which was still being sorted in 1975 and was never replaced. A ⑩ bin, my mother said in 1977, is the only container that improves by being sorted; every bin, she said, is an evening that has agreed to look like a box. She said the evening was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 垃圾桶（指那个容器，与垃圾相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep a bin 放／备一只垃圾桶
D. n. 垃圾桶（指那条街上每一个）
E. n. 垃圾桶（指楼梯下那一个）
F. n. 倒垃圾（指每周倒垃圾那件事）
G. n. 倒垃圾（抽象：那种每周一趟的活儿）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bin by the back door
The bin, meaning the container and not the rubbish
bin was the whole of the evening
The bin, meaning the weekly trip
the bin had become a photograph in a leaflet
The bin of the whole thing

answers.why: keep a bin 意为“放／备一只垃圾桶”，1955 年祖母在后门边放了一只垃圾桶，她说放着就是这习惯的全部。
bin 意为“垃圾桶”，指那个容器而不是垃圾，它星期五清空，星期六被人争论。
bin 指那条街上每一个垃圾桶，那条街上每一个的盖子都不一样。
bin 指楼梯下那一个（放纸的那一个），是唯一有人认真分类的。
bin 意为“倒垃圾”，指每周倒垃圾这件事，父亲说 bin 就是那个傍晚的全部。
bin 为抽象用法，指那种每周一趟的活儿，是屋里人人都注意到、却没人认领的差事。
bin 意为“垃圾桶”，到 1972 年这个 bin 成了宣传单上的一张照片。
bin 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，祖母四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年的星期五和一张分好类的纸。
bin 意为“垃圾桶”，我记得的是楼梯下那一个，1975 年还有人在分类，从没被换掉。
bin 为抽象总称，母亲说垃圾桶是唯一会因为被分类而变好的容器。
